newsitem.title: GERMANY: Real-time Deutsche Telekom prices on Web Nov 18-22.
newsitem.headline: Real-time Deutsche Telekom prices on Web Nov 18-22.

text.p: Deutsche Boerse AG, the holding company for the Frankfurt stock exchange, said on Friday that it would publish real-time stock price quotes on shares of Deutsche Telekom on its home page on the Web next week.
From November 18-22 Telekom share price data will appear on the bourse's home page at http://www.exchange.de and afterward the data will appear with a 15 minute delay.
The bourse will publish price data from both floor trade and the IBIS electronic trading system.

Deutsche Telekom, the German phone giant, will announce the subscription price for its initial public offering on Sunday and shares begin trading in Germany and New York on Monday and a day later in Tokyo.
The company will float up to 690 million shares in what is expected to be Europe's largest ever stock offering.
